Payload:
One actionable documentation inconsistency: [README.md](/C:/Users/Consiliari/.codex/worktrees/model-driven-delivery/Markitect/internal/tooling/codexrunner/README.md:17) says the adapter disables `plugins`, `shell_tool`, and `unified_exec`, but omits `multi_agent`, which the launch arguments disable at [runner.py](/C:/Users/Consiliari/.codex/worktrees/model-driven-delivery/Markitect/internal/tooling/codexrunner/runner.py:993). Severity: low; update the README sentence.

The reviewed adapter delta otherwise meets the requested source checks: it omits both suppression flags; enforces read-only mode, four disabled features, and a 1–600 second timeout; binds the model and accepted reasoning effort as literal arguments; derives the output schema from the invocation; and rejects all `modelOptions` keys except bounded `model_reasoning_effort`. The tests capture `Popen` argv with a fake process, without a provider call.

The native-entry delta consistently directs authors to `.markitect/project.yaml`, `markitect project schema`, and `markitect project index --repo PATH` for the selected model and current Manager identities. It distinguishes `markitect project init` from historical top-level `markitect init`. Source validity does not establish product readiness or approval.
findingDisposition: Low README omission of multi_agent repaired; no post-review executable change.
